timing: Written after the two-replicate estimand bridge and before generating any data for this study.
purpose: Isolate sensitivity to the Person population shape on identical MFRM structures while preserving FACETS/Python JMLE parity and keeping joint, marginal, and conditional likelihood claims separate.

preflight.role: Operational, identity, resume, parser, and direction checks only; no bias or estimator-ordering claim.

screening.role: Hypothesis screening with Monte Carlo standard errors; still below the repository's 100-eligible-replicate study-depth threshold.

confirmatory_minimum.role: Minimum depth before operating-characteristic language; requires a prospective amendment fixing selected contrasts and precision targets.

data_generating_design.person_standardization: Each realized Person vector is centered and scaled to population SD 0.8 so population shape, not realized variance, is the manipulated axis.

person_distributions.symmetric_mixture: Equal-probability two-component Gaussian mixture before centering and scaling.
person_distributions.heavy_tail_t3: Student t with 3 degrees of freedom before centering and scaling.

observation_designs.complete: All Person x Rater x Task x Criterion rows.
observation_designs.planned_connected: Each Person is observed by two adjacent Raters in the registered ring; the full constrained PCM design must remain rank-full.

data_generating_design.pairing: Within replicate, all distribution/design conditions reuse the same row-level uniforms. Complete and planned-connected conditions also share the retained complete responses before masking.

fit_contracts_per_dataset.role: Same-estimand engine parity; FACETS Umean=6 main output plus separate Umean=2 Table 8 auxiliary output.

fit_contracts_per_dataset.estimand: Normal Person population marginal likelihood with SD fixed to the registered 0.8.
fit_contracts_per_dataset.role: Distribution-shape misspecification sensitivity at matched first two moments.

fit_contracts_per_dataset.estimand: Normal Person population marginal likelihood with SD estimated.
fit_contracts_per_dataset.role: Distribution-shape and design sensitivity transmitted through estimated population dispersion.

fit_contracts_per_dataset.estimand: Exact conditional likelihood given Person totals.
fit_contracts_per_dataset.role: Distribution-free structural calibration conditional on informative totals; extreme-Person loss remains explicit.

execution_contract.immutable_manifest: Preparation writes retained inputs and SHA-256 hashes once; workers never regenerate data.
execution_contract.sharding: Attempt rows are deterministically assigned by manifest row number modulo shard count.
execution_contract.resume: Each attempt writes a completion marker last. Resume skips only markers whose plan, input, and attempt fingerprints match; mismatches fail closed.
execution_contract.aggregation: Aggregation is read-only over attempt artifacts and reports missing, duplicate, failed, and included attempts without silently changing denominators.

preflight_gates.input_identity: All retained bundle hashes and attempt input fingerprints match.
preflight_gates.structural: All complete and planned-connected PCM designs have nullity 0.
preflight_gates.facets_python_parity: 8/8 contracts comparison-eligible and direct-agreement pass under the already qualified tolerances.
preflight_gates.mml: 16/16 fits return, converge, are inference-ready, contain finite parameters, and satisfy registered constraints.
preflight_gates.cmle: 8/8 audits are conditionally rank-full and fits pass convergence, finite-MLE, finite-parameter, and constraint gates.
preflight_gates.resume_replay: A second identical worker invocation skips every completed assigned attempt and changes no completed marker hash.

screening_outputs: Per-condition eligible denominator and failure taxonomy.
Main-facet and PCM-threshold signed error, MAE, and RMSE by estimator, distribution, and design.
Free-SD MML error relative to registered realized SD 0.8.
CMLE informative/extreme Person counts and their association with recovery, without treating excluded extremes as recovered parameters.
Paired replicate contrasts against the normal distribution with Monte Carlo mean, SD, SE, and an explicitly screening-only normal-approximation interval.
FACETS versus Python JMLE direct-agreement metrics kept separate from different-estimand sensitivity.
withheld_claims: No estimator winner or automatic estimator recommendation from preflight or 20-replicate screening.
No cross-basis log-likelihood, AIC, or BIC comparison.
No coverage, power, false-positive, or model-selection error-rate claim in this correct-PCM shape study.
No assertion that CMLE is unaffected by Person distribution when the distribution changes the rate of extreme or weakly informative totals.
No claim that matching mean and SD makes the normal MML model correctly specified for non-normal conditions.
escalation_rule: Proceed from preflight to 20-replicate screening only if every preflight gate passes. Proceed toward 100 eligible replicates only after a result-blind amendment selects contrasts and precision targets; a visually favorable preflight or screening estimate is not an escalation criterion.
